mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want to frame my basement ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by checking how much headroom you have and what needs to be hidden in the ceiling, like ductwork, pipes, beams, or wiring. In Denver-area basements, ceiling framing is usually planned around those obstacles so the finished space keeps as much usable height as possible while still allowing proper drywall or a drop ceiling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure ceiling height, locate ductwork, plumbing, and beams, then decide whether you need a flat drywall ceiling, soffits, or a dropped section to cover utilities.
